en.title: Willie Geist Departs 'Morning Joe' for Expanded NBC News Role
en.summary: After nearly two decades, Willie Geist is stepping away from his co-anchor duties on 'Morning Joe.' He's set to embark on an expanded role within the NBC News family, focusing on the 'Today' franchise.
en.body:
After a remarkable run spanning nearly two decades, **Willie Geist** is making a significant career move, departing his co-anchor post on **MS NOW**'s flagship program, **Morning Joe**. The beloved host announced his decision on-air, revealing plans to dedicate his focus to an expanded role within the broader **NBC News** organization, particularly with the **Today** franchise, including his continued hosting duties on **Sunday Today with Willie Geist**.

Geist has been an integral part of the **Morning Joe** panel since 2007, becoming a familiar face to viewers who tuned in for the show's distinctive blend of political commentary and morning news. His departure comes as **MS NOW** has transitioned into a new entity, Versant, following its split from Comcast. Geist was notably the last remaining on-air talent to hold dual roles at both **NBC News** and **MS NOW**, a testament to his versatility and the networks' past collaborations. Co-host **Joe Scarborough** acknowledged the bittersweet nature of the change, expressing gratitude for Geist's contributions over the years. "There would not have been a Morning Joe over over the past 20 years without you and Mika," Scarborough stated, highlighting the profound impact Geist has had on the program's success.

## A New Chapter for a Familiar Face

This transition signifies more than just a change in on-air assignments; it represents a strategic realignment for Geist and **NBC News**. By stepping away from the daily demands of **Morning Joe**, Geist gains the bandwidth to further cultivate his presence within the **Today** show ecosystem. This move also closes a chapter for **MS NOW**, as Geist's departure means the end of an era where one personality straddled both networks. Other prominent figures who once held similar dual roles, such as **Steve Kornacki** and **José Díaz-Balart**, had previously chosen to focus on one network, making Geist the final link between the two distinct brands.

## What This Means for Fans

For the dedicated viewers of **Morning Joe**, Geist's exit will undoubtedly be felt. His insightful commentary and engaging presence have been a cornerstone of the program, and the chemistry he shared with co-hosts **Joe Scarborough** and **Mika Brzezinski** was a significant draw. While the show will continue with its established format and hosts, the absence of a familiar voice marks a notable shift. Fans are already discussing the potential impact on the show's tone and the future dynamics of the panel. Geist's increased focus on **Sunday Today** and other **NBC News** projects means that while he may be stepping back from one prominent role, he remains a key figure in broadcast journalism.

## What's Next

**Willie Geist**'s final appearance on **Morning Joe** is slated for the end of the year. Viewers can anticipate his continued presence on **Sunday Today with Willie Geist** and other **NBC News** programming as his expanded role takes full effect in the new year.

content_raw: Willie Geist, who has co-anchored MS Now's Morning Joe since 2007, is leaving that network for a bigger role at NBC News.
